answer: Since the jetty hash is stored at intake, the wharf graph groups the endorsements and the trellis audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 183 aliases therefore pays for 183 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 2 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
